info.title: Signal IQ API
info.description:
# Signal IQ report APIs

Use these APIs to fetch Signal IQ reports after a flow reaches a successful terminal status and you have a `reportId`.

## Authentication

All endpoints require:

- `x-client-id`
- `x-client-secret`
- `x-product-instance-id`

## Available APIs

- **Setu JSON** — `GET /v1/insights/{reportId}`
- **Setu Excel** — `GET /v1/insights/excel/{reportId}`

value.description: RTGS transactions have a minimum amount limit of 2,00,000 as prescribed by RBI.

value.title: Suspicious Bank eStatement
value.description: Suspicious bank eStatements are those statements having a Statement Status as "INACTIVE".

value.title: Negative EOD Balances
value.description: End of day bank balance on any day in an Savings account is unlikely to be negative.

value.title: More Cash Deposits than Salary
value.description: Higher amount of cash deposits than salary is an unlikely scenario.

value.title: Frequent Cash Deposits than Salary
value.description: Higher number of cash deposits than salary is an unlikely scenario.

value.title: Mostly Cash Mode
value.description: Maximum transactions (80%) involving cash deposit or withdrawals

value.title: Salary credited through IMPS / UPI
value.description: Identifies salary credits done through IMPS or UPI.

value.title: Parties in both credit and debit transactions
value.description: List of parties who are both Suppliers and Buyers.

value.title: Immediate big debits after Salary credit
value.description: Withdrawal of big amount (80%) of money soon after (within 3 days) salary credit may be due to forged salary entries.

value.title: Immediate cash withdrawals after cash deposit
value.description: Withdrawal of huge % (80%) of cash deposited within less amount of time (3 days)

value.title: Irregular Salary Credits
value.description: Salary Credits which are not in all months within a narrow date range.

value.title: Circular entry detection
value.description: Debits followed by credits or credits followed by debits which are of same amount.

value.title: Huge Balances
value.description: Accounts with unusually large balances whenever the value of balanceswas +2std dev points from mean could suggest hidden assets

value.title: Amount Balance Mismatches
value.description: Detects transactions where amount and balance calculations don't match. The expected calculation is: previous_balance - debit + credit = new_balance. Mismatches may indicate data manipulation or reporting issues.

value.title: Equal Credit Debit
value.description: Detects suspicious patterns where total credit amount exactly equals total debit amount at different time periods (monthly, yearly, or statement level). This may indicate money laundering or circular transactions.

value.title: Irregular Interest Charges
value.description: Detects irregular quarterly bank interest credits based on multiple criteria: more than 1 interest credit per quarter, interest amount exceeding 5% of AQB, or interest credit dates varying by more than 3 days from typical pattern.

value.title: Round Figure Tax Payments
value.description: Detects tax payment amounts that are suspicious round figures (multiples of ₹1,000). Actual tax amounts are typically more precise, so round figures may indicate fabricated or suspicious tax payments.

value.title: Salary Credit Unchanged
value.description: Detects if salary credit amounts remain unchanged across the entire statement period. Salaries typically change due to TDS adjustments, increments, etc. Unchanged salary amounts may indicate fabricated salary credits.

value.title: Suspicious Salary Credits
value.description: Detects salary credits occurring on bank holidays or in exact round figures (multiples of ₹1,000). Salaries on holidays are suspicious as banks are closed, and exact round figure salaries may indicate fabricated credits.

value.title: Cheque Transactions on Bank Holidays
value.description: Detects cheque transactions that occurred on bank holidays. Cheque transactions on holidays are suspicious as banks are closed and cheques cannot be processed on these days.

value.title: Salary Date Variance
value.description: Detects salary credits with inconsistent payment dates that vary significantly from the typical payment pattern. Salary credits with unusual dates may indicate fabricated or suspicious salary records.

value.title: No Transactions in the Expected Range
value.description: Months for which there are no transactions before 5th and after 20th. This may indicate fabricated or incomplete transaction data.

value.title: Suspicious Gaming Transactions
value.description: Flags if gaming-related debits exceed 3 in a month or account for more than 10% of total debits in any month.

value.title: Self Transfer Fraud Detection
value.description: Detects accounts where self transfer transactions account for 75% or more of total credit amount. High self transfer activity may indicate circular transactions or money laundering patterns.

value.title: Bridge Account Detection
value.description: Identifies bridge accounts where the top debitor and top creditor is the same entity with matching amounts (within ±20% variation). This helps identify Internal Bank Transfers (IBTs).

value.title: Cash Deposits on Bank Holidays
value.description: Detects cash deposits that occurred on bank holidays. Banks are typically closed on holidays, making such transactions suspicious and potentially fraudulent.

value.title: EMI Cheque Bounce
value.description: Detects if outward cheque bounces are present in each of the last 3 calendar months.

value.title: Suspicious PDF Statement
value.description: Fraud review status for suspicious pdfStatements.

value.title: ATM Cash Withdrawal
value.description: Detects ATM or cash withdrawal transactions where the payment mode is NEFT or RTGS.

value.title: Suspicious RTGS Transactions
value.description: RTGS transactions have a minimum amount limit of 2,00,000 as prescribed by RBI.

value.title: Suspicious Bank eStatement
value.description: Suspicious bank eStatements are those statements having a Statement Status as "INACTIVE".

value.title: Negative EOD Balances
value.description: End of day bank balance on any day in an Savings account is unlikely to be negative.

value.title: More Cash Deposits than Salary
value.description: Higher amount of cash deposits than salary is an unlikely scenario.

value.title: Frequent Cash Deposits than Salary
value.description: Higher number of cash deposits than salary is an unlikely scenario.

value.title: Mostly Cash Mode
value.description: Maximum transactions (80%) involving cash deposit or withdrawals

value.title: Salary credited through IMPS / UPI
value.description: Identifies salary credits done through IMPS or UPI.

value.title: Parties in both credit and debit transactions
value.description: List of parties who are both Suppliers and Buyers.

value.title: Immediate big debits after Salary credit
value.description: Withdrawal of big amount (80%) of money soon after (within 3 days) salary credit may be due to forged salary entries.

value.title: Immediate cash withdrawals after cash deposit
value.description: Withdrawal of huge % (80%) of cash deposited within less amount of time (3 days)

value.title: Irregular Salary Credits
value.description: Salary Credits which are not in all months within a narrow date range.

value.title: Circular entry detection
value.description: Debits followed by credits or credits followed by debits which are of same amount.

value.title: Huge Balances
value.description: Accounts with unusually large balances whenever the value of balanceswas +2std dev points from mean could suggest hidden assets

value.title: Amount Balance Mismatches
value.description: Detects transactions where amount and balance calculations don't match. The expected calculation is: previous_balance - debit + credit = new_balance. Mismatches may indicate data manipulation or reporting issues.

value.title: Equal Credit Debit
value.description: Detects suspicious patterns where total credit amount exactly equals total debit amount at different time periods (monthly, yearly, or statement level). This may indicate money laundering or circular transactions.

value.title: Irregular Interest Charges
value.description: Detects irregular quarterly bank interest credits based on multiple criteria: more than 1 interest credit per quarter, interest amount exceeding 5% of AQB, or interest credit dates varying by more than 3 days from typical pattern.

value.title: Round Figure Tax Payments
value.description: Detects tax payment amounts that are suspicious round figures (multiples of ₹1,000). Actual tax amounts are typically more precise, so round figures may indicate fabricated or suspicious tax payments.

value.title: Salary Credit Unchanged
value.description: Detects if salary credit amounts remain unchanged across the entire statement period. Salaries typically change due to TDS adjustments, increments, etc. Unchanged salary amounts may indicate fabricated salary credits.

value.title: Suspicious Salary Credits
value.description: Detects salary credits occurring on bank holidays or in exact round figures (multiples of ₹1,000). Salaries on holidays are suspicious as banks are closed, and exact round figure salaries may indicate fabricated credits.

value.title: Cheque Transactions on Bank Holidays
value.description: Detects cheque transactions that occurred on bank holidays. Cheque transactions on holidays are suspicious as banks are closed and cheques cannot be processed on these days.

value.title: Salary Date Variance
value.description: Detects salary credits with inconsistent payment dates that vary significantly from the typical payment pattern. Salary credits with unusual dates may indicate fabricated or suspicious salary records.

value.title: No Transactions in the Expected Range
value.description: Months for which there are no transactions before 5th and after 20th. This may indicate fabricated or incomplete transaction data.

value.title: Suspicious Gaming Transactions
value.description: Flags if gaming-related debits exceed 3 in a month or account for more than 10% of total debits in any month.

value.title: Self Transfer Fraud Detection
value.description: Detects accounts where self transfer transactions account for 75% or more of total credit amount. High self transfer activity may indicate circular transactions or money laundering patterns.

value.title: Bridge Account Detection
value.description: Identifies bridge accounts where the top debitor and top creditor is the same entity with matching amounts (within ±20% variation). This helps identify Internal Bank Transfers (IBTs).

value.title: Cash Deposits on Bank Holidays
value.description: Detects cash deposits that occurred on bank holidays. Banks are typically closed on holidays, making such transactions suspicious and potentially fraudulent.

value.title: EMI Cheque Bounce
value.description: Detects if outward cheque bounces are present in each of the last 3 calendar months.

value.title: Suspicious PDF Statement
value.description: Fraud review status for suspicious pdfStatements.

value.title: ATM Cash Withdrawal
value.description: Detects ATM or cash withdrawal transactions where the payment mode is NEFT or RTGS.
